title: Portsmouth Art & Cultural Center

services.name: WAVY - Exhibits and Events
services.desc: From timeless to cutting edge, comforting to controversial, local artists to national traveling exhibits, come explore our ever-changing array of visual, cultural and historical expression. This compelling exhibition explores the history of the Norfolk County Courthouse (now the Portsmouth Art & Cultural center) and its powerful role in shaping law, justice and memory in the region. We’re bringing art outside this summer with large-format prints of original artwork displayed around the square. Meet this year’s artist lineup below and click any name to explore more of their work-then vote for your favorite. The artist with the most votes will receive their own exhibition! Enjoy unlimited

blurb: Housed in the 1846 Courthouse, the Portsmouth Art & Cultural Center offers engaging visual, cultural and educational experiences in the arts through renowned rotating exhibits, lectures, classes.
